notes: Seed http://co.wise.tx.us/ returned HTTP 403 and www.co.wise.tx.us was refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). One web search located the same CivicPlus Elections page also served at www.ems.co.wise.tx.us/315/Elections, which the fetch module read. Clarity: results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Wise/elections.json returned HTTP 403 (not 404), and the county page has no Clarity link, so no EIDs were available and none were probed. The Elections page lists only canvass-time reports: 'May 26, 2026 Joint Primary Runoff Election Final Official Cumulative Results Report', 'March 3, 2026 Joint Primary Election Official Cumulative Results Report', reconciliation forms and hand count audits; no election-night report remains. 2024 general results were not examined beyond this list. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data branch not found). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-D): 2024_general UNDETERMINED to LATER (check 3). The wayback-data harvest has two election-night captures of www.co.wise.tx.us/315/Elections (22:59 and 02:03 CST) that link only 'Unofficial Cumulative Report - Final' (View/5970) and '- Early Voting' (View/5969); both files, fetched today through www.ems.co.wise.tx.us, are Hart cumulative county-total reports printed 9:14 PM and 6:37 PM on 11/05/2024; the 2024 precinct report (View/6011) is 'Official Results' run 11/18/2024. DocumentCenter sends no Last-Modified, so there is no upload time; the capture itself shows the 9:14 PM report was posted by 22:59. 2026 primary and runoff stay UNDETERMINED: no election-night captures (harvest found none), the Elections page and Election Results Archive (/317) list only official cumulative reports, and the Wise County Messenger primary story (published 2026-03-03, updated 2026-03-04 09:15 EST) gives county totals only, a lead that the county posted unofficial final results that night. Sweep pending (phase1/targeted/sweep/Wise not on wayback-data).

View/5970 is a 'Cumulative Results Report Wise County, Texas Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 41 of 41 = 100.00% Run Time 9:14 PM Run Date 11/05/2024' (PDF CreationDate 2024-11-06 03:14 UTC), county totals by vote type only. View/5969 is the same report with 'Precincts Reporting 0 of 41', 'Run Time 6:37 PM Run Date 11/05/2024'. Precinct numbers first appear in 'November 5, 2024 General and Special Election Precinct Results Report' (View/6011), 'Precinct Results Report Official Results ... Run Time 2:28 PM Run Date 11/18/2024', after election night. The server sends no Last-Modified, so printed run times are the only file times.
